name: Winter's Symphonies
source:
The winter never fails to bring surprises... haven't you noticed, Sophie?

"You once uttered these words with such sincerity―it pains me to admit that I really hadn't. Looking back, though... winter's symphonies certainly carry many connotations to me. The nasty surprises. And all the wonderful things along the way, too; with you, Charles, and Jenny by my side. My past goal of paving a road for myself, tainted by ghosts of the past lurking in the dark... those sure were the days."

A regretful past, a confusing present, and an unclear future. After shutting the door to a life many would envy, the protagonist of the story, Sophie, returns to her one and only hometown. The town is just as she remembers it. She, however, is not. She can't help seeing herself as empty―as empty as the barren trees around her. One calling abandoned, with no clear path ahead: what is her true purpose in life, now that time has faded the malicious spell of vanity? Furthermore, how will she deal with crippling regret and guilt she carries?

When the wonderful symphonies of winter season sound over the city – as they do every year – will the powers of supposed miracle "fate" steer her life in a predetermined manner?
translation:
冬天总是会带来惊喜……你没有注意到吗，苏菲？

“你曾经如此真诚地说过这些话——让我痛苦地承认我真的没有。不过，回想起来……冬天的交响曲确实给我带来了很多内涵。令人讨厌的惊喜。还有一路上所有美好的事情；有你、查尔斯和珍妮在我身边。我过去为自己铺平道路的目标，被潜伏在黑暗中的过去的幽灵玷污了……那些确实是那些日子。”

令人遗憾的过去，迷茫的现在，以及不明朗的未来。在关闭了许多人羡慕的生活之后，故事的主人公苏菲回到了她唯一的家乡。这个小镇还是她记忆中的样子。然而她不是。她不禁觉得自己很空虚——就像她周围光秃秃的树木一样空虚。一种召唤被放弃，前方没有清晰的道路：既然时间已经褪去了虚荣的恶意咒语，她人生的真正目的是什么？此外，她将如何处理她所承受的严重遗憾和内疚？

当冬季美妙的交响乐在城市上空响起时——就像每年一样——所谓的奇迹“命运”的力量会以预定的方式引导她的生活吗？
